thread:
incidentbot: paging @alice_sre for high error rate on /v1/generate (prod-us-west)

alice_sre: seeing a sharp spike in 5xxs, ~18% error rate last 3m, CPU on gpux-rt nodes topping 95% and queue depth climbing.

carol_runtime: confirmed, can repro with internal load test. tail latency exploded for >512-token requests. continuous-batching backlog grew.

alice_sre: quick customer-impact check: cs reports 2 paid customers seeing elevated errors (acct: acme-inc, acct: marketlytics). emily_custsu can you confirm severity?

emily_custsu: acme-inc reports timeouts on their chat endpoints, tickets open. marketlytics hitting retries, some data loss risk. Both flagged P1 to accounts.

bob_oncall: I'm on it, handing off to @bob_oncall (taking over). Alice, status and any mitigations in flight?

alice_sre: short-term mitigations proposed:
- apply per-customer temporary token rate limit for heavy keys
- increase batching window to favor throughput (accept higher p95 latency) to reduce queue overflow
- disable the long-context variant (model-x-32k) for hosted tier to reduce memory pressure

carol_runtime: agree. runtime flag to increase batch window: `POST /admin/runtime/config` payload:
```
{"continuous_batching.max_window_ms": 120, "continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens": 65536}
```
This will increase batching aggregation from 20ms -> 120ms and allow larger batches.

dan_prod: we should also add a temporary quota: `PUT /admin/quotas/acme-inc` `{ "rps": 8 }` and same for marketlytics. Lower than normal but prevents thundering herd.

bob_oncall: executing rate limits now for acme-inc and marketlytics. applied and confirmed.

deploy-bot: runtime config update started by carol_runtime: change continuous_batching.max_window_ms -> 120, max_batch_tokens -> 65536.

bob_oncall: applying model variant disable for model-x-32k on hosted pool (route -> fallback to model-x-8k). This will reduce mem footprint.

deploy-bot: model routing update applied. 2 nodes drained and restarted with new routing rules.

alice_sre: after rate limits + routing change: error rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in 4m. queue depth decreasing. Good signal.

carol_runtime: note — p95 latency increased from ~90ms -> ~360ms for large requests after batch window bump. p50 still fine. This is expected tradeoff for throughput.

emily_custsu: relaying to acme-inc: errors are down, but their interactive UX may see lag. They're OK with degraded latency for the next 1.5h while we stabilize.

bob_oncall: leaving mitigation in place for 90 minutes of peak. I will escalate to infra tomorrow for a longer-term config: smarter adaptive windowing + per-route thresholds.

carol_runtime: logging config in ops playbook and opening follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-4321 "Adaptive batch windows + per-customer shaping". Will include A/B plan.

alice_sre: handing off final oncall to @bob_oncall. bob, checklist: confirm limits, monitor error rate, p95, and customer tickets. add note to incident log.

bob_oncall: acknowledged. will monitor dashboards, setting slack alert thresholds to error_rate>6% and queue_depth>200.

alice_sre: thanks team. :white_check_mark: Closing active paging to alice, keeping thread for follow-up notes and retrospective.

incidentbot: incident cleared from paging for alice_sre.
